title.how: useHead({ title }) or useSeoMeta({ title }) on each page.

contentInHtml.how: Universal rendering, the default, server-renders each page.

csp.how: A policy string written by hand into routeRules headers.
csp.note: The usual module, nuxt-security, is a community package.

frameOptions.how: A header written by hand into routeRules headers.

robots.note: From the template, not the framework.

sitemap.how: A file or server route written by hand, or a community module.
sitemap.note: @nuxtjs/sitemap is a community module (Nuxt SEO), not the core team's.

canonical.how: useHead({ link: [{ rel: 'canonical', href }] }), the link written by hand.

jsonLd.how: A useHead script entry of type application/ld+json, written by hand.
